raw.query: WITH folds(fold) AS (VALUES ('F1'),('F3'),('F4'),('F6'),('F7')), cost AS (SELECT substring(run_id from 'g4:(F[1-7])_') AS fold, substring(run_id from 'rho([0-9]+)')::int AS rho, provisioned_worker_seconds FROM provenance.v_pool_cost WHERE is_current=true AND run_id ~ '^g4:F[1-7]_enc_fc_rho(10|15|20|25)$'), base AS (SELECT substring(run_id from 'g4:(F[1-7])_') AS fold, provisioned_worker_seconds AS c8_ws FROM provenance.v_pool_cost WHERE is_current=true AND run_id ~ '^g4:F[1-7]_enc_static_C8$'), lat AS (SELECT substring(d.run_id from 'g4:(F[1-7])_') AS fold, d.rho, l.p99_ms FROM provenance.v_dim d JOIN provenance.v_pool_latency l USING (run_id) WHERE d.is_current=true AND l.is_current=true AND d.run_id ~ '^g4:F[1-7]_enc_fc_rho(10|15|20|25)$'), per_fold AS (SELECT c.fold, MAX(c.provisioned_worker_seconds) FILTER (WHERE c.rho=15)/MAX(b.c8_ws) AS rho15_ratio, MAX(l.p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE l.rho=15) AS rho15_p99_ms, MIN(c.provisioned_worker_seconds) FILTER (WHERE l.p99_ms <= 1000) AS cheapest_feasible_ws, MAX(c.provisioned_worker_seconds) FILTER (WHERE c.rho=15) AS rho15_ws FROM cost c JOIN base b USING (fold) JOIN lat l USING (fold,rho) GROUP BY c.fold) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM provenance.v_cost_ratio WHERE is_current=true AND run_id ~ '^g4:F[1-7]_enc_fc_rho15$') AS owning_view_rows, MIN(p.rho15_ratio) FILTER (WHERE p.fold IN (SELECT fold FROM folds)) AS burst_min_ratio, MAX(p.rho15_ratio) FILTER (WHERE p.fold IN (SELECT fold FROM folds)) AS burst_max_ratio, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.rho15_p99_ms <= 1000) AS rho15_feasible_folds, COUNT(*) AS total_folds, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.rho15_ws = p.cheapest_feasible_ws) AS rho15_cheapest_folds, json_agg(json_build_object('fold',p.fold,'ratio',p.rho15_ratio,'p99_ms',p.rho15_p99_ms,'rho15_is_cheapest',p.rho15_ws=p.cheapest_feasible_ws) ORDER BY p.fold) AS fold_breakdown FROM per_fold p
